errors.text: The hypothesis changes the target from a lamellar FCC/B2 Al0.7CoCrFeNi eutectic alloy to unrelated refractory or W-based alloy systems.
It omits the defining 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2 h HPHT intervention and instead proposes ordinary stepwise annealing and aging.

The proposed precipitate-hardening mechanism does not reconstruct the target mechanism of hierarchical pattern formation, coherent FCC/B2 interfaces, dislocation transfer, and activation of multiple deformation modes.
The cited evidence directly supports the processing route only in a specific W-Ni-Fe-Ta alloy, not in the suggested NbMoTaW or Ta-Nb-Hf-Zr-Ti examples.
